create_remote_sandbox: create a RemoteSandboxBackend instance and call create() to provision a sandbox Pod and NodePort Service via the provisioner
destroy_remote_sandbox: destroy a RemoteSandboxBackend sandbox by calling destroy() with a SandboxInfo object to tear down the Pod and Service
check_remote_sandbox_alive: check if a RemoteSandboxBackend sandbox is running by calling is_alive() with a SandboxInfo object
discover_remote_sandbox: discover an existing RemoteSandboxBackend sandbox by calling discover() with a sandbox_id string
review_remote_sandbox_backend: review the RemoteSandboxBackend class and its four lifecycle methods: create, destroy, is_alive, discover
